title: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella adopts AGI-pilled outlook
excerpt: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella stated he is now AGI-pilled regarding potential changes to economic and political structures.
body_html:
Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella has stated that he is now "AGI-pilled." His comments focus on the potential for artificial general intelligence to bring about startling changes to the structure of the economy and political systems.

Nadella raised questions regarding how the political economy might organize itself around AGI capabilities.
